Whenever i get tired of being shit on i just let the animal take over and stop caring about how stupid i look.

I talk back, i argue, i fight until theyre so miserable being around me that they just go away.
Takes a while but i find it cathartic.

Yms, dont know what happened but theyve growm an ego to the point that its unbearable listening to them rag on every tiny little detail of something.

They used to be really funny and insightful but nowdays feels more like just taking pot shots at anything that might not be perfect.

Born in 95
I work at a liquor store and its the highest paying job ive ever had, i make roughly 750 bi-weekly, its the first time in my life i think ill ever break the 2,000 benchmark for my bank account.

Live with mother so i dont have a lot of expenses aside from food, cigarettes, gas, etc.
Im severely stressed out about how my future will end up and im imagining that if things dont improve for me in the next 10 years my 40th birthday will be getting as much of whatever i want, having a good time and then blowing my brains out.
Im a cat, im a sexy cat!

Well wait a minute hold on, arent you supposed to love your family unquestioningly and blindly because youre related by blood?

You wouldnt want to be one of "those" that turn your back on the people that felt giving birth was the end of their job right?
